reviews.text:
I really like this moisturizer, especially when my skin feels dry. The texture is rich but it spreads nicely and doesn’t feel heavy on the skin.

It makes my skin feel very soft and hydrated, and I notice a nice healthy glow after applying it. I usually use it as the last step of my skincare and it keeps my skin comfortable for hours.

A little goes a long way and the jar is quite big, so it lasts a long time. If you have dry skin or want a nourishing cream, I think you’ll enjoy this one.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢款保濕霜，尤其係皮膚感覺乾燥嗰陣。質地豐潤，但係好容易推開，塗喺皮膚上唔會覺得厚重。

佢令我皮膚感覺好軟、好水潤，塗完之後會見到好健康嘅光澤。我通常用嚟做護膚步驟嘅最後一步，佢可以令我皮膚保持舒服好幾個鐘。

一點點已經好夠，而且罐子好大，所以用得好耐。如果你皮膚乾燥或者想要滋養嘅面霜，我諗你會鍾意呢款。

reviews.text: I really enjoy using the MARY & MAY Idebenone Blackberry Intense Cream. The texture is rich but absorbs nicely into the skin, leaving it soft, hydrated, and glowing. With regular use, my skin feels smoother and looks healthier. I also love that it’s fragrance-free, which makes it gentle for sensitive skin. A lovely addition to my skincare routine! 💛🧈✨
reviews.zh: 我真係好享受用 MARY & MAY Idebenone Blackberry Intense Cream。質地豐潤，但好快滲入皮膚，令皮膚柔軟、水潤、有光澤。經常用，我嘅皮膚睇落順滑咗，又健康咗。我仲鍾意佢係無香料，對敏感皮膚嚟講好温和。係護膚步驟中嘅好補充！💛🧈✨

reviews.text:
I really like the texture of this cream. It feels rich but still absorbs well and doesn’t leave the skin greasy. The formula with idebenone and blackberry extract makes it feel like a very antioxidant-focused moisturizer.
My skin feels comfortable and hydrated after using it, especially in the evening routine. It works well with other skincare products and doesn’t pill.
Overall it feels like a well-balanced cream if you want something nourishing but not overly heavy.
reviews.zh:
我真係好鍾意呢款面霜嘅質地。佢質地豐潤，但仍然吸收得好好，唔會令皮膚油膩。含有 idebenone 同黑莓萃取嘅配方，令佢好似一款以抗氧化為主嘅保濕霜。
塗完之後，我嘅皮膚感覺舒服、水潤，特別係晚上護膚嗰陣。佢同其他護膚品配合得好好，而且唔會搓泥。
總括嚟講，如果你想要一款有滋養效果，但唔會太厚重嘅面霜，我覺得佢係一款平衡得好好嘅面霜。

reviews.text: I’m really impressed with this Korean skincare product. The texture feels lightweight yet nourishing, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasiness. After consistent use, my skin looks healthier, more radiant, and well-hydrated. I also appreciate the gentle formula that works perfectly even for sensitive skin. Definitely a high-quality product that delivers visible results!
reviews.zh: 我對呢款韓國護膚品好驚喜。質地輕盈但有滋養，吸收快，唔會留低油膩感。持續使用之後，我嘅皮膚睇落更健康、更有光澤、水潤咗。我仲欣賞佢嘅温和配方，甚至啱敏感皮膚用。絕對係一款優質產品，效果睇得到！

reviews.text: "This Idebenone Blackberry Intense Cream is so nourishing and rich! The texture feels buttery but absorbs nicely without leaving a heavy film. My skin feels deeply moisturized, soft, and plump the next morning. It also gives a healthy glow and helps with dryness. A perfect cream for night care, especially if you need extra
reviews.zh: 「呢款 Idebenone Blackberry Intense Cream 好滋潤、好豐富！質地好似牛油咁，但係吸收得好好，唔會留低厚厚嘅膜。塗完之後，皮膚第二朝摸落深層滋潤、軟熟，仲有啲飽滿。佢仲會帶嚟健康嘅光澤，又幫助改善乾燥。係夜間護理嘅完美面霜，尤其係如果你需要多啲

reviews.text:
yes it is silly and smooth and has thicker texture. my skin is dry to combination texture and I only used this in the night time only, bc it contains different kind of ceramides, I decided to check it out and buy one since I read the other comments helps them out with their wrinkles, 
I have not noticed anything improvement yet since i only used them in couple of times. 
you can see it shiny and smooth.
reviews.zh: 係，佢幾絲滑，質地厚啲。我皮膚係乾性至混合性，我只係晚上用，因為佢含有唔同種類嘅神經酰胺，我就決定試吓，同買一個，因為我睇過其他評論話佢哋有助改善皺紋。暫時我未見到有任何改善，因為我只係用咗幾次。你可以見到佢睇落亮晶晶同平滑。

reviews.text: I was unsure if I'd like this for my combination skin as the reviews couldn't seem to agree on the texture. It's a buttery, medium weight moisturizer that I find sinks in well. It's slightly to heavy for me but works well at night, I wouldn't use it during the day. It hasn't broken me out so far and I like the packaging so pretty happy overall
reviews.zh: 我本來唔肯定呢款係咪啱我嘅混合皮膚，因為評論嘅質地描述唔一致。佢係牛油質地、中等重量嘅保濕霜，我覺得吸收得幾好。對我嚟講稍微厚咗少少，但係晚上用好啱，日間我唔會用。到而家都冇令我爆痘，我都好鍾意包裝，整體都幾滿意。

reviews.text: I bought this because of the ceramides in it, but quickly learned it wasn't as soothing as I thought it would be- (don't leave yet, it's still a good product). This cream is very moisturizing, and while it is thick, it's not heavy. It's very cosmetically elegant. I've been loving it for the winter at night time, and now that it's starting to get hot I've still used it comfortably at night. I'd recommend this for combo and dry skin (I have combo leaning dry skin), though oily skin may want to avoid it because of the thickness.
reviews.zh: 我買呢款係因為佢有神經酰胺，但好快發現佢冇我想像中咁舒緩——（唔好走，佢仍然係一款好產品）。呢款面霜好保濕，雖然質地厚，但唔會覺得厚重。佢非常有質感。我冬天晚上一直都用，而家天開始熱咗，我晚上仍然用得舒服。我會推薦畀混合偏乾性皮膚嘅人（我係混合偏乾），不過油性皮膚可能要避開，因為太厚。
